open: Give the machine as a .glb or .gltf file ("model"), or list its parts in "parts" and replace the placeholder blocks in machine.js with real geometry built from the reference.
Real dimensions and the one input that drives it (angle, stroke or speed) go in kin.js. Without them the page shows the model and its parts but no readouts.
